facts.fact: Telma (AXIAN Telecom press release, 10 February 2023) states Madagascar has three existing international subsea cables, EASSy, LION and METISS, all reaching the country through Telma's national backbone; landing stations are not named for these three.

systems.tiers: landed at Mahajanga; East system expected ready for service Q4 2023, not yet in service at the date of the release
